_comment: Generate dark photon absorption rates for SrCd2Sb2 using QCDark2-informed ELF (Si measured optical dielectric, scissors-shifted direct gap = 2.1 eV). Intermediate model between Drude (hypmat_unscreened) and true SrCd2Sb2 ELF. Generate .dat file first: python3 utils/build_darkphoton_hypmat_qcdark2_elf.py --darkelf_dir <path>
